text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Air Shakur-san,
look over here, please!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Next, please follow me this way!

Today was Air Shakur's press interview day. Since she's
usually reluctant to do interviews, many reporters gathered to hear what she had to say.
Since this shoot focuses primarily on her racing racewear, most of the questions were related to that—

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: It leaves a rather edgy impression overall; does it reflect your own personal tastes?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Define "edgy" for me...
If we're talkin' personal taste, well, I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text: Is your everyday fashion similar in style to this racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I already told you, "if you consider it a preference, then yes."
What is your next question?

Air Shakur answered matter-of-factly, and the Q&A session went smoothly.
Then...

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I asked you
a question, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please share your thoughts on
Air Shakur's racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
By specifically asking for "number one"...
does that mean in comparison to the other girls?

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
"...That's the word, but
what are your thoughts on that, Air Shakur?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Their preconceived notions aren't anything new.
The answer is 'I don't give a damn.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ain't no mistakin' that
I'm "number one," right?

The interview proceeded smoothly after that,
and we eventually reached the final question.

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
"Like yourself"... you say,
but what part of me do you mean, for example?
choice_data_list: It's in complete harmony with her individuality.

text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur inherently possesses a very striking look.
Even so, there's no toning it down—
choice_data_list: I think you're bringing out an appeal that resonates with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text: That's true! It really brings out Air Shakur-san's glamorous charm even more.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Gorgeous?

The interview proceeded smoothly after that,
and we eventually reached the final question.

text_block_list.name: Reporter F
text_block_list.text: —Could you tell us what specific points you focused on when designing your racing silks?

Air Shakur's dedication to her racing outfit
was nothing short of extraordinary.

First, it started with searching for a trustworthy designer, then selecting materials, the fine details of the horseshoes...
She was thoroughly involved until every single aspect met her satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"—A truly beautiful program operates quietly
without drawing attention to itself."

The calculated trimming of the fabric, the scarf
chosen to accommodate her quirks... There were so
many details to explain. Just as I thought that—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Preferences, huh?
...Like I'd care 'bout that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's obvious just by looking.

text_block_list.name: Reporter F
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Shakur-san?

Air Shakur suddenly slips out from the surrounding crowd,
takes her position at the start of the track, and—
Bursting forward in an instant as if in sync with the starter's gun, the scarf at her waist fluttering as she rounded the course, and then...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, crap!
I was totally captivated! A photo!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That answers your last question, right?
The interview is over.

text_block_list.name: Reporter F
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
You haven't answered my question yet!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I already "showed" you the answer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm going back ahead.
Just wrap things up whenever.

text_block_list.name: Reporter F
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san...
Just what does this mean...?

She doesn't lie. That means she must have shown the steps leading to the answer up to this point.
If I can just figure that out, then naturally—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"—A truly beautiful program operates quietly
without drawing attention to itself."
...Air Shakur showed that her program functioned. It drew every single pair of eyes *strictly* to her running.
choice_data_list: I think the answer is probably—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey.
Did you... see this article?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Each thread becomes a number, and perfectly
knitted formulas point to a simple solution:
'Running.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Showing eccentricity in the paddock, and sharpened beauty on the track—
her racing suit truly is a 'suit.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's with this over-the-top hype?
I never said nothin' like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Annoying.
Stop acting like you know everything.
